items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Jimmy' in the context of Walter Page leaving a band, and later discusses 'Jimmy Miller' (guitarist) and 'Jimmy Lunceford' separately. The specific 'Jimmy' in the final turn is identified as being in the Andy Kirk band, but the interviewee only confirms he was not in the Jet

ctx.x: Wow, that was a good band.
Sure. Sidney Catlett and then when Sidney went back to join Fletcher Henderson in Chicago, then Jo Jones joined the band. And Walter Page, after Jimmy left.
